who.title: Who we are
who.body: This platform helps brands find and contact content creators in India. We are the data fiduciary for the personal data described here under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

what.title: What we collect and why
what.body: Account details (name, email, password hash) to run your account. Your 18+ confirmation and consent records, to prove valid consent. For creators: location, languages, categories, profile details, connected social account IDs and public statistics, to show your profile to brands. For brands: brand name, industry and website. Messages, requests, deals and ratings, to run collaborations. Security logs (IP address, device, sign-in times), to protect accounts.

notCollected.title: What we don't collect
notCollected.body: Aadhaar, PAN, date of birth, home address, bank or UPI details, social media passwords, device contacts or location.

sharing.title: Who sees your data
sharing.body: Brands see only creators' public profile fields and statistics, never their email or phone. We use service providers for hosting, email and error tracking under written contracts, and we store data in India. We don't sell personal data.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Until you delete your account. Unverified sign-ups are deleted after 7 days, inactive accounts after 3 years (with 30 days' warning), and security logs after one year.

rights.title: Your rights and choices
rights.body: You can download your data, correct it, withdraw marketing consent and delete your account from settings. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it. Requests that need our help are answered within 30 days.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.body: Contact our grievance officer first (see the grievance page). If you're not satisfied, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: Users must be 18 or older. Brands and creators deal with each other directly; the platform does not handle payments between them. Sponsored posts must be labelled (#ad, #collab). Don't share fake statistics, harass other users or misuse their data. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

grievance.title: Grievance officer
grievance.body: For privacy questions, complaints or data requests, contact our grievance officer. We acknowledge complaints promptly and answer within the time the law requires.

emails.footer: You received this email because of activity on your Creator Platform account. If this wasn't you, you can ignore it or contact our grievance officer.
